data.name: Cabezurrio vs Robots 2.0
data.detailed_description:
A platform game in which you control Cabezurrio, a soldier who must collect all the gems and destroy every robot in his path across various settings. You are equipped with a rifle to shoot the robots, and you can also throw grenades. Robots require multiple hits to be destroyed—some may need to be taken down with bullets, while others require grenades. The robots will fire back, attempting to stop you from reaching your goal; you will also face missile launchers and cannons aiming to hit you. The game is packed with constant explosions, and you must learn the behavior of each robot to eliminate them as efficiently as possible. There is no limit to your ammunition, allowing you to unleash a hail of bullets.

The game features 4 settings (desert, castle, jungle, and a night sky with a fighter jet) and 3 difficulty levels (easy, medium, and hard), totaling 12 stages. To advance to the next stage, you must collect all the gems and destroy all the robots. As the difficulty level increases, you will need to collect more gems and destroy more robots. Furthermore, additional in-game elements will make completing each level increasingly challenging.

In the fourth setting, Cabezurrio pilots a fighter jet capable of firing missiles and dropping bombs. He will face various types of robots that make the mission significantly more difficult.

You begin the game with 30 lives.

Character movement is controlled via the keyboard (with the option to rebind keys), though a game controller can also be used. Pressing the pause button opens a menu that allows you to resume play, return to the main menu, or exit the game. Pressing the pause button again will resume the action.
